title: C-O5: executor image and host runbook — Dockerfile, compose file and the human steps to log the accounts in, with nothing secret in the repo
spec:
Why: the executor runs on kenta-server (Ubuntu 20.04, Docker) in its own container so Claude Code, Codex, uv, git and gh get a current userland and the credentials live in mounted host files. Dockerfile: FROM ubuntu:24.04; install ca-certificates, curl, git, gh (GitHub CLI apt repo), python3, uv (official installer), Claude Code via the native installer documented at code.claude.com/docs/en/setup (not npm), Codex CLI from the openai/codex GitHub release for linux x86_64 (pin the version in an ARG with a comment on how to bump; verify `codex --version` in the build); copy this repo to /opt/orchestrator and `uv sync --frozen`; entrypoint `uv run orchestrator serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8090`; non-root user `orch` with HOME=/home/orch. docker-compose.executor.yml: service `orchestrator-executor`, build ., volumes ./work:/work, ${ORCH_CREDS}/claude-a:/home/orch/.claude-a, ${ORCH_CREDS}/claude-b:/home/orch/.claude-b, ${ORCH_CREDS}/codex:/home/orch/.codex, ${ORCH_CREDS}/gh:/home/orch/.config/gh; env_file ./executor.env (gitignored; holds ORCH_SERVICE_TOKEN, CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN_A, CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN_B, ORCH_NOTIFY_URL, GH_READ_TOKEN); healthcheck curl /healthz; restart unless-stopped; no published ports (reached on the home docker network by the kgpt module). .dockerignore: wt/, .venv/, .orchestrator/runs, .orchestrator/bus.sqlite*, graphify-out/. docs/executor-host.md runbook, written for the human: prerequisites; create the creds dirs on the host; on the laptop run `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-a claude setup-token` and the same for b, paste each token into executor.env (never into git); `codex login --device-auth` inside the container once (docker compose run --rm orchestrator-executor codex login --device-auth) so auth.json lands in the mounted volume; `gh auth login` likewise; pool.toml on the host: set oauth_token_env = "CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN_A" / "_B" (from C-O2a) and role secrets to env: form; repos.toml entry for kgpt; smoke test with curl against /healthz and a POST /goals on a scratch repo; how to rotate a token; what to check when a goal does not start (planner log path). Add executor.env to .gitignore. README.md: link the runbook from "Use on a project".
(Recreated from T-0106: re-pointed at the recreated C-O4)
acceptance: `docker build .` succeeds locally (record the image size in the task result) and `docker run --rm <image> sh -c 'claude --version && codex --version && uv --version && gh --version'` prints four versions

docker-compose.executor.yml validates with `docker compose -f docker-compose.executor.yml config` given a dummy executor.env, publishes no ports, and mounts exactly the four credential dirs plus ./work
docs/executor-host.md contains every human step above, and the words token, secret or password never appear next to a value anywhere in the diff; executor.env is in .gitignore
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` still green (tests/test_install.py may assert the new .dockerignore lines are NOT copied to targets)

result.summary: superseded by C-O5 v2 (next id after T-0164): spec review T-0162 requested changes (UID/GID alignment of mounted creds, version pins, objective secret check, protected-paths for the credential mounts). Specs are immutable, so recreated.

spec_review_risks.issue: Credential dirs are bind-mounted into non-root user orch's HOME with no UID/GID alignment; host dirs created by a plain mkdir per the runbook will likely be owned by a different UID, breaking `codex login --device-auth` / claude token writes into the mounted volumes with a permission error only discoverable at runtime on kenta-server.

Codex CLI version is pinned via ARG but Claude Code and uv are installed via their 'latest' installer scripts with no pin, so the same Dockerfile is reproducible for one dependency and not the other two.

Acceptance criterion 'the words token, secret or password never appear next to a value' is not objectively checkable: the doc must legitimately name env vars like CLAUDE_OAUTH_TOKEN_A and ORCH_SERVICE_TOKEN, which contain the word 'token' as part of the identifier, not as a leaked value.

The optional acceptance clause ('may assert the new .dockerignore lines are NOT copied to targets') references behavior install.py's IGNORE_LINES scaffold doesn't have today — a test written against it would pass trivially without pinning down any real implementation requirement.

New host credential directories under ${ORCH_CREDS} (claude-a, claude-b, codex, gh) are never added to guardrails' protected-paths list, which today only covers ~/.claude-a, ~/.claude-b, ~/.codex paths directly. A Planner/scout with Bash access on kenta-server is not blocked from touching the executor's mounted credentials since this file is out of scope and unmentioned.
